100 ads 8 angles 18 proven winners

Start at The Formula — it's what the 18 proven winners do that the 19 strugglers don't, measured rather than guessed. Ad Ideas turns that into eight ads you could shoot this week for the US and PH. Swipe File is the raw evidence, creative included.

What a winner actually looks like

Of the 100 ads swept, 18 scored 81+ (GetHookd's Optimized and Winning tiers) and 19 scored 40 or below. Comparing those two groups directly is the whole trick — it separates what works in this niche from what merely looks like advertising. The single loudest finding: winners are shorter, plainer, and older than they look.

Body copy length
171vs271
Median characters. Winners write 37% less. Long copy is the most common unforced error in this set.
Opening line
57vs75
Median characters before the first line break — roughly what shows before "See more".
Days left running
136vs3
Winners have been live for months. A three-day-old ad hasn't told you anything yet.

The rules that fall out of it

Each of these is held up by the numbers above, not by advertising folklore. Build the ad, then check it against the list.

Eight ads to shoot this week

Drafts built to the formula: under 180 characters, no pasted links, no question hooks, no discount lead, two to four emoji, and a creative you can shoot on a phone. The PH set is written in Taglish because the highest-scoring ads in the whole sweep were the ones speaking their market's own language. These are untested drafts — the point is to run them, not to trust them.
